digest_basis: source index integration digest, source cutoff commit, and ordered feed candidate ids

selection_policy.include: Immediate/high decision relevance plus either a materially under-evaluated O gap or distinct new mechanism, with traceable primary quantitative evidence.
selection_policy.exclude: Confirmatory overlap, speculative remedies whose failure premise is stronger than intervention evidence, candidates still missing read-only relevance assessment, and worker-authored O novelty judgments from the legacy transition batch.
selection_policy.novelty_note: Dedicated novelty comparator is absent at this cutoff. No item is labeled globally novel; each included item is conservatively labeled materially_under_evaluated from read-only relevance-comparator overlap analysis.

independence_note: Current exploration artifacts are a transition batch whose search-path independence from O is not certified. External evidence is retained, but O overlap/novelty/relevance fields below come from comparators/integrator only and are never written back to research_workers.

items.mechanism: Measure matched error/co-failure dependence before counting model calls, reviewers, or agents as independent evidence; use effective independence rather than raw panel size.

novelty.basis: O requires independent evidence but the relevance comparator found no measured internal failure-dependence calibration.

evidence.summary: 18,000 preregistered paired missions found same-model co-failure on 90.0% of missions where either failed (phi 0.916); a separate nine-judge study estimated only about 2.18 effective votes and large independence-model gaps.

relevance.why_now: Changes how internal corroboration/quorums should be interpreted without weakening the independent production-evidence gate.

items.scope: Contract tasks and judge panels; effect sizes must be recalibrated on O tasks/models.

items.mechanism: Preserve best validated intermediate evidence independently of chronology; store provenance-bound scoped Repairs/Guards/Withheld records and keep evidence validity separate from transfer applicability.

novelty.basis: O already has Episodes/Candidates/provenance but lacks explicit best-valid-intermediate retention plus applicability state.

evidence.summary: Across 30 adaptations, 26/30 had a later valid round beat the first while 22/30 ended below an earlier best; provenance audits were strong, while automatic applicability remained weak (25% Apply precision).

relevance.why_now: Extends the existing evidence lifecycle without requiring a new architecture; explicitly avoids importing the weak applicability classifier.

items.scope: One-company industrial recommendation adaptations; production lifts are not framework-level causal evidence.

items.mechanism: Audit retrieved datasets/empirical artifacts with bounded cross-source, statistical, contextual, and provenance checks before research evidence affects decisions; source identity alone is not semantic integrity.

novelty.basis: Comparator found O has source-identity provenance but no semantic data-integrity audit for external research ingestion.

evidence.summary: In 450 contained runs, indirect poisoned data caused 49.56% compromised conclusions with only 6.0% spontaneous detection; a scientist persona left 16.67% compromise, while a five-check audit had zero observed attack successes in the tested setup.

relevance.why_now: Directly guards the external research feed before evidence becomes O decision context.

items.scope: Five topics and one poisoning construction; zero observed failures is not a universal security guarantee and false-positive/latency cost remains to test.

items.mechanism: Before evaluator scores control selection or learning, test invariance to semantics-preserving nuisance/proxy perturbations against stronger semantic labels/endpoints where available.

novelty.basis: O recognizes evaluator fallibility but the relevance comparator found no general proxy-invariance stress suite.

evidence.summary: Findings ACL 2026 reports evaluator/reward-hacking detection precision/recall 78.4/81.7 in RL and 74.2/78.6 for LLM evaluation; mitigation improved human win rate by 8.3 pp and reduced RL reward hacking by 54.6%.

relevance.why_now: Falsifies evaluator validity directly rather than adding another judge.

items.scope: Perturbations and labels are task-specific; the stress detector is not itself a truth oracle.

items.mechanism: When a deterministic endpoint exists, keep it as the actual success signal; use dense LLM rubrics only for diagnostics, and report repeated reliability separately from any-pass capability.

novelty.basis: Strongly aligned with O's evidence hierarchy but adds explicit diagnostic separation and replicate reporting.

evidence.summary: scBench-Long: 125/1,068 endpoint successes (11.7%); four rubric judges agreed strongly with each other yet rubric score correlated only r=0.29 with the deterministic endpoint; strongest model-harness passed at least one replicate on 8/21 tasks but all three on only 2/21.

relevance.why_now: A low-complexity evaluator refinement wherever O has machine-checkable endpoints.

items.scope: Single-cell benchmark; rubric calibration and endpoint availability are domain-specific.

items.mechanism: Track wrong commitments by violated reference, origin, resolved/active state, and terminal footprint; do not convert every local mistake into terminal negative evidence.

novelty.basis: O already scopes negative evidence but the comparator found no explicit resolved/active/terminal error lifecycle representation.

evidence.summary: TrajDebug pilot found 7.62 local errors per failed trajectory but only one critical; 61.9% of noncritical errors later repaired. Diagnosis-derived guidance improved same-task re-execution by 10.8% and held-out transfer by 5.7%. LongRCA still reached only 24.1% exact root-step accuracy.

relevance.why_now: Reduces overbroad negative learning from repaired/local errors while keeping causal uncertainty explicit.

items.scope: Tool/coding trajectories; the exact durable ledger schema is an O adaptation and root-cause attribution remains uncertain.

items.mechanism: Measure whether the agent can state the authoritative goal/constraint separately from whether subsequent actions actually obey it, including clean authoritative reconstruction versus inherited drifted history.

novelty.basis: Directly overlaps Context Kernel goals but the comparator found missing behavior-level adherence measurement under inherited-context pressure.

evidence.summary: Open-code multi-model experiments show capable target models can inherit predecessor drift, and correct explicit goal identification can coexist with behavior that does not pursue the goal.

relevance.why_now: Direct falsification axis for context-to-action influence; diagnoses the gap without claiming a fix.

items.scope: Simulated stock-trading and ER-triage environments; susceptibility is model/domain conditional.

items.mechanism: Adapt branch allocation/search policy from measured progress and stagnation rather than fixed heuristics while keeping external evaluation and rollback fixed.

novelty.basis: O has method-change triggers but the comparator found routing thresholds/search policy mostly fixed.

evidence.summary: AdaEvolve under equal 50-call budget reports Frontier-CS mean 61.33 versus 50.75 OpenEvolve; selected component ablations degrade when local adaptation, adaptive island selection, or meta-guidance is removed. EvoX separately reports gains from evolving search strategies rather than holding them fixed.

relevance.why_now: Directly targets wasted search time; test a bounded progress-conditioned controller rather than importing a whole evolutionary system.

items.scope: Strongest causal ablations are optimization/search tasks, not the full O work loop.

held_back_high_value.reason: Evidence comparator grade A-, but latest read-only relevance/novelty comparison has not yet covered it.
Evidence comparator B+ and causal sign-reversal is important; await O-overlap/relevance assessment.
Artifact-access evidence B+ but relevance comparator backlog is incomplete.
Immediate-high relevance; held only to keep the feed compact until evidence-comparator coverage catches up.
Immediate-high relevance but system-level component causality is weak; prefer a narrow comparison first.

exact_continuation: At the next immutable cutoff, ingest post-independence worker records and dedicated novelty-comparator output first; then promote held candidates only when novelty, evidence strength, and decision relevance remain separately supported.
